epistemic_scope: Post-hoc single historical case with prospectively frozen interventions; no independent inferential replication claim.

rationale.explanation: Intervene on initial state AFTER uniform placement but BEFORE world.advance, so interventions precede the first shared physical component.
rationale.caveat: This is a nonphysical alteration of initial conditions, not a change to the engine laws.

criteria.intervention: Periodic rigid translation of four initially unbonded S0 particles into unoccupied cells; original identities, species, bonds, energies and RNG state preserved. Each arm cloned from exactly the same seeded post-placement world.
criteria.shams: Two disjoint sets of four S0 particles, greedily matched without reference to future outcomes using toroidal distances to both daughter-seed IDs and occupancy within distance two at step zero; stable tie break by particle ID.
criteria.matching: For each fixed shift, consider a triplet valid ONLY if all three interventions can be placed on empty target cells without collisions and component boundary bond violations. Do not replace a failed shift or select valid shifts based on outcome.
criteria.primary_measure: Exact daughter seed component reaches the frozen four-S0 signature at tick 835 AND retains it at tick 845, with no target group particles in its connected component.
secondary_measures: Exact signature at each of 835 and 845 separately
Original four daughter particle IDs present in matched component at 835 and 845
Material all-six common component at tick 770
First tick of RNG state/draw-count divergence versus baseline
First tick of daughter-seed component signature divergence versus baseline
Initial geometry and local occupancy of moved groups
criteria.comparison: Descriptive within-shift contrast: effect of parent displacement versus two shams and intact baseline. Report every valid/invalid shift; no statistical p-values.
criteria.decision_rule: If <4 valid triplets or early RNG divergence makes matched trajectories noncomparable, mark inconclusive; otherwise report outcome counts with the same causal caution. Never classify signature occurrence as reproduction.

controls.original_run_hash: Exact original M6 final world hash after unaltered replay to tick 3000.
controls.initial_clone_identity: State hash, energy, bonds, RNG state and RNG draws identical before intervention.
controls.invariants: After intervention and at finish, World.check verifies occupancy, bonds, species, ledger and valid geometry.
controls.observation: All callbacks may read material state but not draw RNG or modify world.
controls.negative_controls: Two matched S0 sham sets, exact same 16 shift vectors and validity exclusions.
controls.forbidden: No changes to World.step, chemistry, molecule bonding laws, RNG mechanism, detector v2 or v2.1.

stopping_rule: Do not tune shifts, matching, windows, success metrics or shams after viewing outcomes; any revision requires protocol v2 and new independent run.
verdict_floor: No causal replication demonstrated by this selected case regardless of results.
